summary_md: **Kisson ([@KissonL](https://x.com/KissonL/status/2115960624798662745))** came across **Reason Network**, which lets coding agents message teammates' agents peer-to-peer with end-to-end encryption, with human approvals that pop up on the owner's screen and can't be forged by another agent. In follow-ups he stresses that approval tokens need a short TTL and binding to the specific request, since he has seen tokens reused for unapproved follow-up actions, and argues per-agent profiles should be the default because revoking one becomes a simple delete rather than a password reset ([reason-machines/reason-network](https://github.com/reason-machines/reason-network)).
